Simplified collection, full drawer/page, Overview/Addresses/Wireless/History, workspace-wide assigned/unassigned Wireless register with Overview/History drawer and full-page URLs, focused wireless parent, site and VLAN assignment with bounded lookup, partial updates and return after reassignment, parent-scoped address and wireless collections with child selection/editing, create/edit, failed and denied operations, direct unavailable links, personal columns, paging/search, optional map. VLAN/VRF bounded registers, full record drawers/pages, Overview/History and guarded editing. VLAN/VRF Networks sections include bounded associated subnet navigation and browser return context. Remaining network object surfaces and phase acceptance open. Racks register with complete Overview/Devices/History drawer, personal columns, bounded site/location editing and lazy child device details. Devices register with Overview/Hardware/Placement/Interfaces/Relationships/History drawer, protected partial edits, asset-backed creation, conflict-safe hardware replacement, bounded choices, personal columns and rack-to-device navigation; Interfaces support bounded parent collection, selected child detail, guarded creation/partial editing, conflict-safe device moves and direct URLs within the device drawer. IP/MAC child collections now support direct atomic creation, bounded subnet search, bounded existing-record assignment, detail/edit, conflict-safe interface transfer and confirmed removal with expected-binding checks. Device relationships and hardware replacement are permission-aware, URL-addressed and guarded within the existing device drawer. DNS zone register and parent-scoped record drawers implemented; bounded search/type filters, guarded editing and IP choices. Database and live-browser DNS checkpoint verified. Selected DNS record history is lazy and URL-addressed within the same drawer, with independently preserved paging, dirty-navigation guards, denied/retry states and child-heading focus; DNS checkpoint runtime verified; broader phase acceptance remains open. Circuits now have a bounded register and Overview/Handoffs/History drawer, guarded service-detail editing and parent-scoped paginated handoff browsing with detail URLs. Circuit browsing/service-editing checkpoint verified; bounded provider/contract choices support Ordered circuit creation and focused assignment editing with dirty drafts; handoff creation, detail edits and bounded placement assignment use focused forms inside the circuit drawer; selected handoff history is lazy, parent-authorized and URL-addressed with independent paging and return focus; focused kind and status workflows use partial updates, preserve failed drafts and confirm suspension/disconnection; broader acceptance remains open.
